prompt:
I want to start routing messages through Matrix in addition to Discord. Please register the Matrix channel so it's ready for credentials.

Add `channels.matrix` to openclaw.json with `enabled=false` (we'll flip it on after login), `homeserver` set to `"https://matrix.org"`, and `tokenRef` set to `"credentials/matrix.token"`. Leave Discord alone.

After the change, list the configured channels.

provenance.rationale: Matrix is a built-in OpenClaw channel with its own homeserver field. Registering a Matrix channel pre-credentials follows the documented two-phase onboarding pattern.
